name: agent-overtime
description: Lets the Agent Overtime Mac app show your sessions and subagents in its pixel office. Sends the app only event names, session and subagent ids and names, folder paths, a tool kind and who a message is addressed to, plus, unless you turn Show Details off in the app, shortened file names, edited line counts, task titles, states and ids, and the model, over a local socket only your user can open; nothing leaves this Mac.
